events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day, we look back at the 1994 release of Oasis's iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe'.

angles.name: Album Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since 'Definitely Maybe' dropped. What's your top track from the album that defined a generation?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Which iconic performance do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on this day in 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today, 49 years since his passing. His music continues to shape generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting with The Pretenders continue to rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Release
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic track 'Imagine' was released in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' premiered, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?
